name: @hivemoot/war-room
description: Shared war-room storage layer + redis-lock helper + queen-verdict primitives. Imported by web (HTTP route handlers) and bot (direct internal callers); not published to npm. The consumer's @upstash/redis install is reused by source-level resolution; this package declares it as a devDependency to avoid a dual-package hazard. zod is intentionally NOT a dep here — see queen-verdict.ts header for the file: + symlink resolution rationale.
